title: B2+ · L5 — Salary negotiation
description: Negociar salario en ingles con confianza: contra-ofertas, silencio estrategico, hablar de valor, y cerrar el acuerdo.

questions.prompt: Primera call con la recruiter. Segunda pregunta: 'What are your salary expectations?'
questions.question: The recruiter asks your salary expectation. What's the strongest opening?
options: Based on my research and experience, I'm targeting a range of 120 to 140.
questions.explanation: 'Based on my research + range concreto' es la formula ganadora. Anclar en investigacion (Levels.fyi, Glassdoor) despersonaliza la peticion; usar rango en vez de numero unico da flexibilidad al recruiter para maniobrar. Regla nativa: ancla la banda alta (el numero superior es tu tope real, no el minimo aceptable). Error hispano: 'you decide' — cede todo el poder de negociacion. 'Give me the maximum' suena inmaduro. Registro: siempre USD 'K' o 'k' abreviado en spoken US ('one-twenty K').
examples: Based on my research, I'm looking at a base of 130 to 150K for this scope. → anclaje con research
Given the seniority and market data for similar roles, I'd be targeting the 145 to 165 range. → US register

questions.prompt: El recruiter te llama con oferta: 110K. Tu esperabas 140K. No puedes rechazar de plano.
questions.question: You get a low first offer. Which is the best response?
options: I appreciate the offer — is there any flexibility on the base? I was hoping for something closer to 150.
questions.explanation: Formula magistral: agradecimiento ('I appreciate') + question form ('is there flexibility') + ancla nueva ('closer to 150'). Nunca decir 'too low' seco — cierra la puerta. 'Is there any flexibility?' es lenguaje de negociacion sofisticado: obliga al recruiter a decir SI/NO en vez de defender la cifra. 'Hoping for' hedges suavemente sin exigir. Error hispano cultural: sonar ofendido ('you insult me') destruye la relacion y no consigue nada. En anglo la negociacion se ve como parte esperada del proceso, no como conflicto.
examples: I appreciate the offer. Is there room to move on the base? I was targeting something in the 145 range. → pulido
Thanks for putting that together. Any flexibility on cash, or should we look at equity to bridge the gap? → creativo

questions.statement: After making a counter-offer, staying silent and letting the recruiter respond is a powerful negotiation tactic.
questions.explanation: VERDADERO. El silencio deliberado despues de un ask es la tecnica de negociacion mas poderosa que existe — los humanos odiamos el silencio y tendemos a rellenarlo con concesiones. Regla FBI (Chris Voss): despues de tu numero, cuenta hasta 10 mentalmente antes de hablar. Error hispano frecuente: rellenar el silencio con justificaciones ('...pero si no puede...si es mucho...') — cada palabra extra debilita tu posicion. Registro clave: funciona igual en llamada telefonica y en persona; en llamada el silencio se percibe aun mas incomodo, por eso es aun mas potente.
examples: Recruiter: 'What are you looking for?' You: 'I was hoping for 150.' [Silence — wait 10 seconds] → tension productiva
You: 'Could we get to 160?' [Wait — resist the urge to add anything] → el proximo en hablar suele ceder

questions.prompt: El base salary esta topado. Sabes que hay otras palancas.
questions.question: You want to negotiate beyond base salary. Which is best?
options: I'd like to explore the total comp — is there room on equity, sign-on, or PTO?
questions.explanation: 'Total comp' + enumerar componentes especificos (equity, sign-on, PTO) es lenguaje de senior candidate — muestra que entiendes que compensacion es paquete, no solo base. 'Total comp' es la abreviacion universal en tech US. Colocaciones nativas: 'sign-on bonus' (bono unico al firmar), 'RSU' (restricted stock units), 'accelerated vesting' (vesting acelerado), 'refresh' (nueva entrega anual de acciones). Registro: en Europa 'PTO' se llama 'holiday allowance' (UK) o 'annual leave' — ajusta segun geografia.
examples: Beyond base, is there flexibility on RSUs or a sign-on bonus? → separacion de palancas
I'd like to explore the full package — equity, bonus target, vacation, and remote work policy. → paquete completo

questions.text: I'm excited about the role and the team — I just want to make sure the offer reflects the market for this scope.
questions.explanation: Frase clave de negociacion — expresar entusiasmo PRIMERO desactiva al recruiter, luego pides. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'I'm excited' con /aɪmɪkˈsaɪtɪd/ (linking + weak); 'want to' se reduce a /wɒnə/ ('wanna') en hablado; 'make sure' con catenacion /meɪkʃʊə/. Colocacion nativa clave: 'reflects the market' — apela a datos objetivos, no a tu preferencia personal. Registro tactico: 'for this scope' anade el concepto de responsabilidad, moviendo la negociacion de 'yo' a 'el rol'.
examples: I'm thrilled about joining — I want to be sure the comp reflects the level of impact I'll have.
I'm all-in on the mission — I just want to align on market rate for the role and geo.

questions.prompt: El recruiter te dice: 'Sorry, that's the top of our band for this level.' Base topado, negociacion aparentemente cerrada.
questions.question: The recruiter says 'That's the top of our band.' Which is the best next move?
options: I understand. Could we bridge the gap with a sign-on or accelerated equity vest?
questions.explanation: 'Bridge the gap' + alternativas creativas es negociacion nivel senior — reconoces las restricciones internas del recruiter y le ofreces salida ganadora. Colocaciones nativas: 'bridge the gap' (cubrir la diferencia — metafora de puente), 'accelerated vest' (vesting acelerado, ej: 25% en el primer ano en vez de 4 anos lineal), 'one-time' (unico, no recurrente — importante distinguir bonos). Registro: 'I understand' antes del ask crea partnership vibe, no confrontacion. Error hispano: aceptar seco cuando aun quedan palancas.
examples: Understood on base — could we bridge the gap with a one-time sign-on to acknowledge the move? → tactica sign-on
If base is fixed, could we look at a stronger equity refresh or an accelerated vesting schedule? → tactica equity

questions.prompt: Empareja cada termino de negociacion salarial con su traduccion:
questions.explanation: Seis terminos indispensables del comp vocabulary US. Sin dominarlos, no puedes negociar seriamente en tech americana. Diferencias US/UK importantes: en UK se dice 'stock options' mas que 'RSUs', 'annual leave' en vez de 'PTO', 'joining bonus' en vez de 'sign-on'. 'Vesting' = periodo en que las acciones se hacen realmente tuyas (tipico: 4 anos con 1 ano de cliff — si te vas antes del ano, no llevas nada). Estos terminos son intraducibles funcionalmente.
examples: The offer is 150 base plus RSUs vesting over four years with a one-year cliff. → estructura tipica
Total comp comes to around 220K including the 20K sign-on. → como se comunica el paquete

questions.target: I've received another offer at a higher band. I'd love to make this work — can you take another look at the numbers?
questions.explanation: Uso etico de leverage (otra oferta real, no bluff). Estructura triple: dato factual (another offer) + preferencia (love to make this work) + question form ('can you take another look'). 'I'd love to make this work' suaviza y confirma preferencia por esta empresa. 'Take another look' es peticion no-agresiva (no exige, invita a revisar). Ritmo natural: pausa breve tras 'band.', tono ascendente en la pregunta final. Etica critica: NUNCA mentir sobre ofertas — el mundo tech es pequeno y se detecta.
examples: I have a competing offer at a similar level — I'd really prefer to join you. Any room to close the gap?
There's another opportunity on the table. Could we revisit the number before I make a final decision?

questions.prompt: Te acaban de hacer una oferta buena. El recruiter presiona para que aceptes en la llamada.
questions.question: You want to buy time before accepting. Which is best?
options: Thanks so much — could I take a couple of days to review the details with my family?
questions.explanation: 'Take a couple of days' + 'review with family' es la formula estandar globalmente aceptada — mencionar familia es palanca cultural universal que ningun recruiter puede negar. NUNCA aceptes en la primera llamada aunque te encante — siempre pide 48-72h minimo para leer con calma, comparar y potencialmente renegociar. 'I need think' es error de gramatica ('I need TO think'). Registro: 'couple of days' es 2-3 dias en anglo; 'a few days' se percibe como mas tiempo (3-5 dias).
examples: I really appreciate the offer — could I have 48 hours to review everything properly?
Would you mind if I took the weekend to think it through and come back to you Monday morning?

questions.statement: It's professional to give an exact salary number when asked 'What are you making now?'
questions.explanation: FALSO. En California, NY, WA, Colorado y muchos paises UE es ILEGAL preguntar salario actual (salary history bans). Aunque sea legal, revelar tu numero te ancla en el pasado y te puede costar 10-20% de aumento. La respuesta profesional: pivotar hacia mercado y scope del nuevo rol. Frases nativas de pivot: 'I prefer to focus on the market rate for THIS role', 'My focus is on the total package for the opportunity'. Error hispano cultural: por politeness contestar la pregunta literal — aqui vale mas el interes propio.
examples: I prefer to focus on the market rate for this position rather than my current comp. → pivot educado
I'm targeting X for this role based on the scope and my experience — happy to walk through my reasoning. → pivot con oferta

questions.prompt: Ancla tu numero justificandolo con el alcance del rol (no con tus necesidades).
questions.question: You want to justify a higher ask. Which framing is strongest?
options: I'll be leading a team of eight and owning P&L — that scope typically commands 180 plus.
questions.explanation: Formula magistral: descripcion factual del scope (leading a team, owning P&L) + benchmark de mercado con verbo 'commands'. 'Commands' es LA colocacion nativa aqui — 'a role that commands X' = un rol que obtiene/exige X en el mercado. 'I need money' o 'I deserve it' apelan a necesidad personal — irrelevante para el recruiter. Registro C-suite: hablar de 'P&L ownership' (responsabilidad financiera del negocio) senala nivel director+. Error hispano: apelar al esfuerzo personal en vez del valor entregado.
examples: Given I'll own three product lines with combined ARR of $50M, market for that scope is 200K+.
Directors with this remit typically make 250 to 300 in this region, based on Radford data. → cita fuente concreta

questions.text: If you can get to one seventy-five on base, I'm ready to sign today and turn down the other offer.
questions.explanation: 'If X, then Y' es el cierre mas poderoso en negociacion — hace irresistible al empleador cerrar porque le pones el desenlace en bandeja. Fenomeno de connected speech: 'one seventy-five' se dice como una unidad con stress en '175'; 'get to' se enlaza como /ˈɡet(ə)/ con t-flap US. 'Turn down' es phrasal verb para rechazar formalmente una oferta. Colocacion tactica: 'ready to sign today' comunica commitment total. Registro: 'get to X' en negociacion = alcanzar X, no llegar fisicamente.
examples: If we can land at 200 base, I'm ready to accept on the spot and end this process. → 'on the spot' = inmediatamente
Get me to that number and I'll sign today — no more back and forth. → transparencia final

questions.prompt: Reconoce el error mas destructivo en toda negociacion salarial.
questions.question: Which is the WORST thing to say in a negotiation?
options: I really need this job — I'll take whatever you offer.
Could we explore the equity component?
What's your budget for this role?
questions.explanation: 'I'll take whatever' destruye completamente tu posicion — el recruiter ancla en el minimo y ademas te fichara con la etiqueta 'candidato desesperado' que persistira en tu paquete anual. Aunque genuinamente necesites el trabajo, negociar con confianza es esperado y respetado en anglo. Regla cultural clave: en US no negociar se percibe como falta de skill o falta de seguridad — impacta negativamente la percepcion del hiring manager. Error hispano: mostrar necesidad por autenticidad; aqui es tactico ocultarla.
examples: Weak: I really need this job — please, whatever you can do. → autopiloto perdedor
Strong: I'm excited about the role — let's align on numbers that work for both of us. → framework win-win

questions.statement: It's acceptable to negotiate the offer even after you've verbally agreed to it.
questions.explanation: FALSO. Renegociar tras un 'yes' verbal (aunque no hayas firmado) quema la relacion permanentemente. En anglo el handshake vale como palabra — retractarse se etiqueta como 'reneg' y se comparte en redes profesionales. Regla: NEGOCIA TODO ANTES del yes. Si dudas, di 'let me think it over 24 more hours' — no digas si. Error hispano cultural: en algunas culturas hispanas se acepta renegociar; en anglo profesional es red flag mayor que puede costarte el offer completo.
examples: Correct: Negotiate everything (base, equity, sign-on, start date, title) before saying yes.
Never: 'Actually, on reflection, I need 10K more' after already accepting verbally. → tabu profesional

questions.target: I really appreciate you working with me on this. Once we have it in writing, I'm ready to give notice and start on the 15th.
questions.explanation: Cierre profesional que sella el acuerdo. 'Working with me on this' agradece la flexibilidad sin sonar sumiso. 'In writing' pide contrato formal firmado — NUNCA renuncies al trabajo actual con solo oferta verbal. 'Give notice' es la colocacion nativa para renunciar formalmente al trabajo actual (usualmente 2 semanas US, 1-3 meses UK). Ritmo natural: entonacion calida en 'appreciate', tono firme y practico en 'once we have it in writing'. Contracciones obligatorias: 'I'm', 'we have'.
examples: Thanks for making this work — once the paperwork is signed, I'll hand in my notice and confirm the start date.
Appreciate the partnership on this. Ready to move once I have the formal offer letter in my inbox.
